Invest with Verity

Let your money work in real estate.

Put your funds into carefully selected property projects run with our development partners. Earn agreed returns over a fixed term — then take your capital back or convert it into property.

  1. 01

    Choose a plan

    Pick the amount and tenure that suits your goals.

  2. 02

    Sign your agreement

    Receive a written investment agreement and receipt.

  3. 03

    Earn returns

    Returns are paid on the agreed schedule.

  4. 04

    Exit or own

    At maturity, collect your capital or convert to property.
